class.name: PuertsStringNameUtf8Cache
class.brief_description: Reuses UTF-8 conversions of names passed to script operations.
class.description: Caches UTF-8 conversions of [StringName] values used by [PuertsEnvironment], including global names, property names, and source names. Pass an instance to [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize]. Environments on the same thread can share this cache.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the cached name conversions. Subsequent operations populate the cache as needed.
